_method: Frames sampled from the verification videos in the browser (Avernus 16Zh8jssanc every 1.5s over the run, 50 frames; Flamewall x4Io4zkWVRw every 5s over the run, 84 frames, UI/webcam masked). Each frame downscaled to 320px wide, then: luminance (Rec.709) stats, near-black share (<0.06), bright (>0.5), very bright (>0.8), edge = mean |dL/dx|+|dL/dy| between neighbours, largeScaleVar = share of luminance variance explained by 16x9 block means, bands = mean luminance of 6 horizontal bands top->bottom, hue = chroma-weighted 30-degree bins from red. Values are [p10, median, p90] across frames.

flamewall.note: frames at 297-307s and 382-387s are frozen pause/menu frames; medians barely move without them
